_comment: Intermediate authoring format for the fictional Helvex Biotech ApS Policy/Standard/Control layer (see synthetic-data-spec.md). Human-authored: references capabilities/roles/policies/standards by short 'key', not by pre-computed hash id. build_helvex_graph.py expands this into the same {graph_name, nodes, edges} shape as cra.json/nis2.json/gdpr.json, computing ids per docs/artifacts/ps-domain-concepts.md's identity scheme. Reference date for all next_review_date reasoning in this fixture is 2026-08-01.

roles.name: Clinical Data Steward
roles.description: Internally accountable owner for the integrity, access-logging, and lifecycle handling of clinical trial data records.

roles.name: QA Manager
roles.description: Accountable for quality assurance sign-off on clinical trial data handling and GxP compliance.

capabilities_new.name: Clinical Trial Data Integrity
capabilities_new.description: Capacity to maintain a tamper-evident, GxP Part 11-aligned audit trail of create/modify/delete operations on clinical trial records.

obligations.text: Maintain Access Logging for Clinical Trial Systems
Maintain Tamper-Evident Clinical Data Audit Trail
Conduct Quarterly Clinical Audit Trail Review

requirements.text: Service owners shall ensure access to clinical trial record systems is logged, retained, and reviewable.
Clinical Data Stewards shall ensure access to clinical trial record systems is logged in structured, tamper-evident form, retained for the life of the trial plus 10 years, and reviewable on demand.
requirements._comment: Same obligation key as sop1_req_4_1 on purpose: the underlying duty is unchanged, only tightened -- demonstrates Obligation staying canonical across regulation VERSIONS, not just across different regulations.

requirements.text: Clinical Data Stewards shall maintain a tamper-evident audit trail of all create, modify, and delete operations on clinical trial records, per GxP Part 11 equivalence expectations.
QA Managers shall review the clinical trial record audit trail on a quarterly basis and document sign-off.

policies.title: Data Protection & Security Policy
policies.description: Organizational commitment governing encryption, access control, logging, and data integrity capabilities across Helvex's clinical data platform.

policies.title: Incident & Vulnerability Response Policy
policies.description: Organizational commitment governing detection, reporting, and remediation of security incidents and vulnerabilities.

policies.title: Clinical Data Integrity Policy
policies.description: Draft organizational commitment governing GxP-aligned clinical trial data integrity and associated privacy impact assessment practices.

policies.title: Legacy Asset & Personnel Security Policy
policies.description: Superseded policy for asset inventory, personnel security, and DPO management, retained for audit history.

standards.title: Encryption-at-Rest & In-Transit Standard
standards.description: Technical specification and key-management procedure for encrypting clinical trial data at rest and in transit.

standards.title: Access Control, MFA & Session Standard
standards.description: Procedures for role-based access control, mandatory multi-factor authentication, and session timeout on clinical data systems.

standards.title: Security Log Retention & SIEM Standard
standards.description: Retention and SIEM ingestion requirements for access and security logs across clinical data platform components.

standards.title: Incident Triage & Reporting SLA Standard
standards.description: Defines triage timelines, escalation paths, and regulatory notification SLAs for security incidents.

standards.title: Vulnerability Patch Management SLA Standard
standards.description: Defines patch SLA windows by severity for identified vulnerabilities across the clinical data platform.

standards.title: Clinical Trial Audit Trail Format & Retention Standard
standards.description: Draft schema and retention specification for the tamper-evident clinical trial record audit trail, aligned to GxP Part 11 equivalence expectations.

standards.title: Legacy Asset Inventory & Access Standard
standards.description: Superseded procedure for asset inventory tracking and personnel access provisioning, retained for audit history.

controls.title: Automated Encryption-at-Rest Compliance Check
controls.description: CI/CD policy-as-code check verifying clinical data volumes are encrypted at rest with approved key management.

controls.title: Access Control & MFA Enforcement Audit
controls.description: Automated audit verifying MFA enforcement and role-based access configuration on clinical data systems.

controls.title: Log Retention & SIEM Ingestion Integrity Check
controls.description: Automated check confirming security logs are retained per policy and successfully ingested into the SIEM.

controls.title: Quarterly Incident Triage SLA Review
controls.description: Manual audit review confirming incident triage and regulatory notification SLAs were met over the review period.

controls.title: Automated Vulnerability Patch SLA Check
controls.description: CI/CD check intended to verify vulnerabilities are patched within severity-based SLA windows; not yet implemented.

controls.title: Legacy Asset Inventory Reconciliation
